pages.text: Search the Overworld for a Gatekeeper house. These special structures contain a Gatekeeper villager and an unlit portal leading to Everbright OR Everdawn. Look in plains, mountain, or snowy regions.

Bring emeralds. Trade with the Gatekeeper for a Zeal Lighter, then use it to ignite the portal frame in his house. Bring food, basic gear and a way to mark your return. The Gatekeeper also offers a Blue Journal for deeper advice.
In Everbright, collect diopside gems as part of the optional Prism Lens discovery. Blue Skies has its own dungeons, progression and bosses; the Atlas does not replace them.
